ruling.author: velvetmonkey
ruling.scope: Ben approved PR 245 on 2026-09-05, in his words: "Approve", and reaffirmed it on 2026-09-06 at 11:07 when he approved PR 249 specifically to unblock it, saying of 245 that there was nothing new to decide. PR 245 corrects the installed-tree pin-sites manifest so assertion 269, 'declared installed-tree sites found by git grep match built artifacts', stops failing. That single assertion was blocking PR 250, PR 251 and PR 244 as well as this branch. FIVE protected artifacts are reported and they are NOT equal in kind. TWO are this branch's real work: scripts/installed-tree-pin-sites.json at blob 14d5ee0bb69e1935320bc390d225cd5193bbd4ff, and test/installed-tree-pin.test.cjs at blob 29c7031cc5a2fd0e8ee65d3f6f51cd22c2b4d64c. THREE arrived when the branch was brought up to date with main and are BYTE-IDENTICAL to main; I compared each blob against origin/main myself before writing this: scripts/check-installed-tree-pin-manifest-review.cjs and test/installed-tree-pin-manifest-review.test.cjs came from PR 249, and wasm-spike/verified/pin-history.json came from PR 236. They must appear here because the checker walks every commit in the range rather than the net tree, which is deliberate so an add-then-delete cannot disappear from review. I verified the merge-base and all five blob digests on disk.
retires: The 2026-09-06 ruling from PR 249, base 7470c7fffe93831066eca726ced767e42dbd863e, which merged to main as dba60d3d and no longer applies to any open change.
